title: Spec of a ring map on points and on residue fields
statement: Let $\psi:R\to R'$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\operatorname{Spec}\psi:\operatorname{Spec}R'\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ the induced morphism of schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $\mathfrak p'\subset R'$ be a prime ideal and $\mathfrak p=\psi^{-1}(\mathfrak p')$. (1) $\operatorname{Spec}\psi$ maps the point $\mathfrak p'$ to the point $\mathfrak p$. (2) Let $r:\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R}(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R'}(\mathfrak p')$ be the homomorphism induced by $\operatorname{Spec}\psi$ on residue fields of the schemes [def-weil-residue-field]; let $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=R_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$, $\kappa(\mathfrak p')=R'_{\mathfrak p'}/\mathfrak p'R'_{\mathfrak p'}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $\kappa(\psi):\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ the homomorphism induced by $\psi$ ($r/t\mapsto\psi(r)/\psi(t)$); and let $e_R:\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R}(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, $e_{R'}:\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R'}(\mathfrak p')\to\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ be the isomorphisms induced by the identifications of stalks $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R,\mathfrak p}\cong R_{\mathfrak p}$, $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R',\mathfrak p'}\cong R'_{\mathfrak p'}$ (as in [lem-weil-pbc-spec-residue-field-identification]). Then $e_{R'}\circ r=\kappa(\psi)\circ e_R$.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01HY (schemes-lemma-morphism-into-affine-where-point-goes, line 769: the commutative square Gamma(Y) -> O_{Y,f(x)} -> O_{X,x} <- Gamma(X) and f(x) = the inverse image of m_x), with Lemma 01HV(6) (schemes-lemma-spec-sheaves, O_{Spec R,p} = R_p) and Lemma 01I2 (schemes-lemma-category-affine-schemes); the passage to residue fields is not written in Stacks

proof.text: *Step 1 (the square of global sections, stalks and residue fields).* Write $Y=\operatorname{Spec}R$, $X=\operatorname{Spec}R'$, $f=\operatorname{Spec}\psi:X\to Y$, $x=\mathfrak p'\in X$ and $y=f(x)\in Y$, a prime $\mathfrak q\subset R$. By [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)=R$, $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)=R'$, and $\operatorname{Spec}\psi$ induces $\psi$ on global sections: $f^\sharp_Y=\psi$ (Stacks 01I1/01I2: $\operatorname{Spec}\psi$ is the morphism of affine schemes whose map on global sections is $\psi$). For a point $z$ of a scheme $Z$ let $\gamma_z:\Gamma(Z,\mathcal O_Z)\to\mathcal O_{Z,z}$ be the germ map and $\rho_z:\mathcal O_{Z,z}\to\kappa_Z(z)$ the residue map. The stalk map $f^\sharp_x:\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ of the morphism of locally ringed spaces $f$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] is the map induced on the colimits over the open neighbourhoods $V\ni y$ by the maps $f^\sharp_V:\mathcal O_Y(V)\to\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}V)$, i.e. $f^\sharp_x(\text{germ}_y s)=\text{germ}_x(f^\sharp_V s)$; taking $V=Y$ gives the commutative square of the proof of Stacks 01HY: $f^\sharp_x\circ\gamma_y=\gamma_x\circ\psi:R\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$. Moreover $f^\sharp_x$ is a local homomorphism [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], and the map $r:\kappa_Y(y)\to\kappa_X(x)$ induced by $f$ on residue fields [def-weil-residue-field] is the map induced by $f^\sharp_x$ on residue fields: $r\circ\rho_y=\rho_x\circ f^\sharp_x$. Combining, $(\ast)$ $r\circ\rho_y\circ\gamma_y=\rho_x\circ\gamma_x\circ\psi:R\to\kappa_X(x)$.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma Tag 01HY (lemma-morphism-into-affine-where-point-goes, lines 769-800: the commutative square Gamma(X) -> O_{X,x}, Gamma(Y) -> O_{Y,f(x)}), Lemma Tag 01I1 (lemma-morphism-into-affine, lines 841-950) and Lemma Tag 01I2 (lemma-category-affine-schemes, line 954)

proof.text: *Step 2 (clause (1)).* For a ring $A$ and a prime $\mathfrak a\subset A$, viewed as a point of $\operatorname{Spec}A$, the maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_{\mathfrak a}=\ker\rho_{\mathfrak a}$ of $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}A,\mathfrak a}$ satisfies $\gamma_{\mathfrak a}^{-1}(\mathfrak m_{\mathfrak a})=\ker(\rho_{\mathfrak a}\circ\gamma_{\mathfrak a})=\ker(e_A^{-1}\circ\pi_{\mathfrak a})=\ker\pi_{\mathfrak a}=\mathfrak a$, where $\pi_{\mathfrak a}:A\to\kappa(\mathfrak a)$ and $e_A:\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}A}(\mathfrak a)\cong\kappa(\mathfrak a)$: the second equality is the clause $e_A^{-1}\circ\pi_{\mathfrak a}=\rho_{\mathfrak a}\circ\gamma_{\mathfrak a}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-spec-residue-field-identification], the third holds as $e_A$ is an isomorphism, the last is [lem-weil-pbc-prime-residue-field-algebra] (a). Since $f^\sharp_x$ is local, $f^\sharp_x(\mathfrak m_y)\subseteq\mathfrak m_x$, so $(f^\sharp_x)^{-1}(\mathfrak m_x)$ is a proper ideal (it does not contain $1$) containing the maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_y$, hence equals $\mathfrak m_y$. Therefore, by step 1, $\mathfrak q=\gamma_y^{-1}(\mathfrak m_y)=\gamma_y^{-1}((f^\sharp_x)^{-1}(\mathfrak m_x))=(f^\sharp_x\circ\gamma_y)^{-1}(\mathfrak m_x)=(\gamma_x\circ\psi)^{-1}(\mathfrak m_x)=\psi^{-1}(\gamma_x^{-1}(\mathfrak m_x))=\psi^{-1}(\mathfrak p')=\mathfrak p$ (the case $A=R$, $\mathfrak a=\mathfrak q$ and the case $A=R'$, $\mathfrak a=\mathfrak p'$). So $\operatorname{Spec}\psi(\mathfrak p')=\mathfrak p$; this is Stacks 01HY for $f=\operatorname{Spec}\psi$, and agrees with the description of $\operatorname{Spec}\psi$ on points in Algebra 00E2.

proof.text: *Step 3 (clause (2)).* By step 2, $y=\mathfrak p$, so $r:\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R}(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa_{\operatorname{Spec}R'}(\mathfrak p')$. The map $\kappa(\psi)$ exists and is characterized by $\kappa(\psi)\circ\pi_{\mathfrak p}=\pi_{\mathfrak p'}\circ\psi$: the ring map $\pi_{\mathfrak p'}\circ\psi:R\to\kappa(\mathfrak p')$ kills $\mathfrak p=\psi^{-1}(\mathfrak p')$ (as $\ker\pi_{\mathfrak p'}=\mathfrak p'$) and sends $t\in R\setminus\mathfrak p$ to $\pi_{\mathfrak p'}(\psi(t))\neq0$, a unit of the field $\kappa(\mathfrak p')$, so it factors uniquely as $\lambda\circ\pi_{\mathfrak p}$ ([lem-weil-pbc-prime-residue-field-algebra] (a), (d), (c)); and $\lambda(\overline{r/t})=\lambda(\pi_{\mathfrak p}(r))\lambda(\pi_{\mathfrak p}(t))^{-1}=\overline{\psi(r)/\psi(t)}$, so $\lambda=\kappa(\psi)$. Now compose $(\ast)$ of step 1 with $e_{R'}$ and use $\rho_y\circ\gamma_y=e_R^{-1}\circ\pi_{\mathfrak p}$ and $\rho_x\circ\gamma_x=e_{R'}^{-1}\circ\pi_{\mathfrak p'}$ ([lem-weil-pbc-spec-residue-field-identification] for $R$ at $\mathfrak p$ and for $R'$ at $\mathfrak p'$): $(e_{R'}\circ r\circ e_R^{-1})\circ\pi_{\mathfrak p}=e_{R'}\circ e_{R'}^{-1}\circ\pi_{\mathfrak p'}\circ\psi=\pi_{\mathfrak p'}\circ\psi=\kappa(\psi)\circ\pi_{\mathfrak p}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-prime-residue-field-algebra] (c) (ring maps out of $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ are determined by their composite with $\pi_{\mathfrak p}$), $e_{R'}\circ r\circ e_R^{-1}=\kappa(\psi)$, i.e. $e_{R'}\circ r=\kappa(\psi)\circ e_R$. (Stacks does not write out this passage to residue fields; equivalently, under the stalk identifications $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R,\mathfrak p}\cong R_{\mathfrak p}$, $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R',\mathfrak p'}\cong R'_{\mathfrak p'}$ of Stacks 01HV (6) the stalk map is $r/t\mapsto\psi(r)/\psi(t)$; the argument above works directly on residue fields.)

lemma Spec.residueFieldMap_residueFieldIso_hom :
    (Spec.map φ).residueFieldMap x ≫ (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso S x).hom =
      (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso R ((Spec.map φ) x)).hom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.ResidueField.map _ x.asIdeal φ.hom rfl)
lean.note: One existing declaration per clause: (1) AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_apply in Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme; (2) Spec.residueFieldMap_residueFieldIso_hom in the recorded upstream module, lines 38–53. Its section binds {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S) (x : Spec S), with no further hypotheses. Spec.map_apply is rfl, so ((Spec.map φ) x).asIdeal is definitionally x.asIdeal.comap φ.hom. Both maps and both affine identifications therefore coincide exactly with those in the node.
